SELECT t1.lms_user_id, t1.user_id, t2.user_name, t6.course_name, t8.place_name. t4.company_name FROM m_lms_user t1 INNER JOIN m_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id AND t2.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_company t3 ON t1.lms_user_id = t3.lms_user_id AND t3.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN m_company t4 ON t3.company_id = t4.company_id AND t4.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_course_user t5 ON t1.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id AND t5.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN m_course t6 ON t5.course_id = t6.course_id AND t6.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} AND t6.hidden_flg = #{hiddenFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_place t7 ON t1.lms_user_id = t7.lms_user_id AND t7.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN m_place t8 ON t7.place_id = t8.place_id AND t8.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} WHERE t8.place_id = #{placeId}
AND t6.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND t4.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%')
AND t8.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
